text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Finished! Overall, I'm still slow. But it feels as though I'm gradually getting faster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer? My time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, is that so? I have quite a ways to go, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright has been, by her own terms, fairly diligent in her training. Her run times, though, don't reflect this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is this plan a mistake? Maybe I should have her set a number of milestone goal races instead of shooting straight for G1.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, as if the universe wants to increase my anxiety…
Hahaha! Briiiight! Looks like another perfect victory for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… You're quite swift, Pearl…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'm the fastest in the world! The fastest of fastests!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You, on the other hand, need to start putting in real effort! One could hardly call this a partner run the way you're going. Get serious, girl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid that's easier said than done…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Seeking the Pearl—a globetrotter and self-dubbed "world treasure." She and Mejiro Bright are in the same year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's boastful but has the speed to back herself up. Mejiro Bright pales by comparison.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You and I are in the same year. We are in the same generation of runners.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't you want to compete with me to hold the world in your hands?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I suppose. I think I could do it someday.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Someday"?! You'll morph into a mermaid before someday happens!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even with Seeking the Pearl provoking her, Mejiro Bright is unmoved. The glimmer seems to be gone from her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, I decide to head to the park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer. Come, I want you to see something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Do you see it? The little bird under that tree?
choice_data_list: I see it. It's sitting quite still.
I see it. It's sitting quite still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It sure is. Actually, it was injured a while ago. That's why it's so silent and calm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It's very well-behaved. I'm sure it was nervous all this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It's been holding back because of its injury… But very soon, I'm just sure that it will…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheep, cheep, cheeeeep!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Whew. It's managed to recover beautifully. What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: See, it took flight when the time was right. That little bird understands too. So…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I've kept you waiting, and the end of the year is approaching fast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I have something else to show you. Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Whaaaa?! Unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… You're no longer hopeless all of a sudden! I thought I would beat you easy-peasy like usual…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But you closed in right behind me during the final stretch. How did you do that?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I was so close to victory this time. Perhaps I would have won if the course had been a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: With just another little push… With a bit more practice together with Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can barely believe what I just saw. To think that Mejiro Bright would nearly beat a leading runner like Seeking the Pearl…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can only speculate how this suddenly became possible. Unless…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're correct. But I feel I've recovered to a point that I needn't worry myself further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I take Mejiro Bright to the infirmary to get her legs examined, she shows me some faint marks on her shins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The pain was quite constant, but nothing so serious as to keep me off my feet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I thought I would just bear with it for the time.
choice_data_list: So that's why you were holding yourself back?
So that's why you were holding yourself back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was to keep you from worrying. I decided to wait until I had recovered before telling you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This is a common injury for racers in their junior year. The Mejiro family doctor told me to wait it out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright always moves at her own pace, but underneath the surface…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There were reasons which made it necessary.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry that I didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh no, Trainer. I am the one who should apologize. It was quite dishonest of me to keep this from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We may be late to start, but from this point forward, if I try hard enough, I may be able to run in the Hopeful Stakes, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All this time, she's been resting her wings, healing her injury. I feel hopeful again, like the clouds have parted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day when Mejiro Bright takes off and soars through the big blue sky is around the corner.
